verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help article on data export says users can export a full general ledger and financial statements, on cash or accrual basis, in Excel, CSV and PDF. That covers the core accounting record in open formats, but the documentation does not show that *all* data can be exported in bulk to support leaving. Missing for 10: documented export of invoices, attachments/receipts, rules, customers/vendors and other non-ledger data; an account-wide bulk export or offboarding process; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Yes, you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
